acceptanceRule: Every material judgment-heavy stage must have explicit professional disciplines, specialist coverage, evidence standards, and independent discipline-specific professional-excellence QA, or a documented owner-accepted limitation.

teams.currentGap: The package is strong on deterministic economics, evidence integrity, authority and safe-stop behavior, but those controls do not establish senior procurement, logistics, marketplace, category-risk, or IP/compliance judgment for opportunity recommendations.
teams.qaRequirement: Independent sourcing/economics/category-risk review against exact product equivalence, freight/fulfillment, marketplace economics and policy/IP standards.

teams.currentGap: No material professional judgment product is produced: the lane validates and executes one fixed, owner-approved self-addressed notification packet with zero AI calls.
teams.qaRequirement: Correctness/authority QA is sufficient for this deterministic execution-only pilot; any future authored communication content would trigger G2.5.

teams.currentGap: Evidence Discovery, Reconciliation, Renewal/Spend Watcher and generic Evidence/QA roles cover the workflow, but do not prove specialist competence across billing operations, commercial terms, usage/entitlement and spend optimization.
teams.qaRequirement: Independent billing/commercial review able to reject financially or contractually weak recommendations, not only stale/duplicate/unsafe evidence.

teams.currentGap: The team is referenced by Factory history/registry but no canonical run-007 package exists on the audited Factory branch. Professional completeness cannot be established from a label or historical summary.
teams.qaRequirement: Canonicalize the team, then map each material output to the relevant independent technical discipline QA.

teams.currentGap: The proposed core spans source identity, provenance, approvals, notifications, health, cost, retention, recovery and dependency management. That is several professional engineering/control disciplines, while current acceptance is primarily structural and operational.
teams.qaRequirement: Independent architecture, security/privacy and reliability review with discipline-specific acceptance criteria before downstream teams depend on the core.

teams.team: Run 009 — Municipal Development Intelligence / Project Radar
teams.currentGap: A canonical implementation directory exists, but it lacks a top-level canonical README/team capability contract on the audited branch. Software publishing/telemetry tests cannot substitute for professional interpretation of planning, development stage or procurement signals.
teams.qaRequirement: Independent municipal-development specialist review tied to authoritative records, stage interpretation, freshness and claim scope.

teams.currentGap: Registry/history references exist but no canonical run-010 package exists on the audited Factory branch.
teams.qaRequirement: Canonicalize the team and require independent financial/contract audit standards before any recovery claim is considered professionally complete.

teams.currentGap: A broad opportunity-scoring rubric is not equivalent to professional coverage across market, finance, strategy and the opportunity's underlying domain; the canonical run package is absent from the audited branch.
teams.qaRequirement: Canonicalize and require independent challenge by the disciplines material to each opportunity rather than one generic opportunity QA.

teams.currentGap: The team label spans multiple distinct commercial professions and its canonical run package is absent from the audited branch.
teams.qaRequirement: Canonicalize and split professional QA across research/qualification, copy, sales/pricing and customer-success outputs.

teams.currentGap: The seven-role chain is operationally complete, but Product Spec, Implementation and Challenger/QA remain too broad to prove senior capability in every applicable software discipline.
teams.qaRequirement: Independent engineering QA must be routed by discipline and cannot treat passing tests/security checks as proof of senior product/UX/engineering quality.

teams.currentGap: The team explicitly combines benchmarking, UX architecture, art direction, design systems, interaction design, frontend polish, responsive/accessibility review and visual QA; that breadth must be backed by named specialist coverage rather than a generic UI specialist identity or score alone.
teams.qaRequirement: Independent UX, visual-design and accessibility excellence review with evidence-backed acceptance criteria in addition to UIX-100 scoring.

teams.currentGap: The hybrid topology is structurally efficient, but four reasoning agents cannot by themselves demonstrate strong-human-professional expertise across the 20-domain taxonomy. General technology, medicine, defense and cross-domain synthesis are still broader than the disciplines they judge.
teams.qaRequirement: Use routed/on-demand domain specialists and domain-specific evidence/QA rubrics; a single generic independent QA role is insufficient for all 20 domains.

teams.team: Alibaba to eBay Public Sourcing Intelligence
teams.currentGap: Specialized design artifacts exist outside the canonical Factory run tree, but no canonical package was found on the audited branch. Its role split is stronger than many teams, yet procurement/logistics/category expertise still requires explicit G2.5 coverage.
teams.qaRequirement: Canonicalize the package and require independent sourcing, logistics/economics, policy/IP and category-specific QA.

teams.currentGap: QUAL -> DIAG -> OUT -> PROP -> PROD -> QA is operational decomposition, not professional decomposition. Production and QA especially hide several independent disciplines.
teams.qaRequirement: Separate commercial/copy/design/engineering excellence gates; generic asset QA cannot approve all of them.

teams.currentGap: The new G2.5 evaluator exists, but the current team-builder still exposes gates A0/B0/G0/G1/G2/G3 and does not invoke G2.5. The professional gate is therefore not yet on the mandatory compilation path and can be bypassed.
teams.qaRequirement: Wire G2.5 fail-closed into build/promotion contracts and make portfolio audit status a governed Factory invariant.
